Maya (CS): Quick share — built a tiny go-live "cheatcode" we've started using for riskier accounts: 1) small warm prefill for top 5 intents, 2) streaming with 2-token heartbeats, 3) tenant-scoped cache with 60s TTL and soft-fallback. Goal: cut cold-starts and give CS a safety-net during demos. Thoughts?

Rafael (SRE): Love this. Two quick q's: how are you triggering prefill? manual from CS or automated on first traffic? Also watch out for prefix cache churn on multi-tenant bursts.

Maya (CS): Mostly CS kicks it off from the Console right before demo (button we added). For top customers we flip the "prefill" toggle. Thinking about an automated rule for >X seats.

Jules (Eng): If we automate, prefer event-based: on tenant.create or when →usage_rate exceeds threshold for 5m. Also recommend limiting prefill concurrency per host to avoid noisy neighbor.

Priya (Solutions): Example prefill payload we've used (keeps things tiny):
```
POST /v1/prefill
{
  "tenant_id": "acct-1234",
  "intents": ["greet","billing-q","reset-pw","onboard-step1","summary"],
  "batch_size": 4,
  "stream": true
}
```
Works well with batch_size 2-4 for low-latency customers.

Samira (Customer): FYI this helped in last week's demo — the agent responded faster and we avoided the awkward pause. :tada:

Rafael (SRE): On the caching side: tenant-scoped cache + 60s TTL is fine, but add a soft-fallback to a regional shared cache if tenant cache miss rate > 30% in a minute. That prevents repeated cold runs.

Maya (CS): Good call. How would we surface hit/miss rates to CS? We need a short dashboard tile.

Jules (Eng): We can emit two metrics per tenant: prefill.hit_count and prefill.miss_count (tags: region, model_variant). Then a simple ratio on the Console. Also add a trace span for prefill latency.

Priya (Solutions): Operational advice for CS during kickoff:
- Start prefill 2-3m before demo start.
- If Pre-fill miss rate > 50% after first 2m, switch to canary model (lower capacity flavor) and notify SRE.
- Use streaming heartbeats (2-token) to show progress to user UI.

Maya (CS): Could we add a tiny checklist in the onboarding Slack modal? e.g., "Start prefill, confirm model variant, check prefill hit ratio". CS often forgets the toggle in busy moments.

Rafael (SRE): Yep. Also add a deploy-bot alert when automated prefill fails >3 times in a row for a tenant. deploy-bot: do we have a suitable alert channel?

deploy-bot: Alert route configured: #eng-oncall -> #customer-success-escalations for prefill failures >3 in 5m.

Samira (Customer): One operational gotcha we hit — when customers have highly personalized system prompts, prefill can be less effective. For those tenants we fall back to streaming-only and a longer lived warm pool.

Jules (Eng): That's expected. Proposal: add a heuristic to detect personalization density (e.g., prompt length + variable tokens). If density > threshold, increase batch TTL to 5m or use warm-pool allocations.

Priya (Solutions): Example Console copy for CS to use in kickoffs: "We run a quick prefill of the most common requests 2–3 minutes before your demo to reduce response latency. If anything goes sideways we have an automated fallback that keeps the demo running."

Maya (CS): Love it. Final checklist (draft):
- Toggle prefill (Console) 2–3m before start
- Confirm model variant pinned for the session
- Check prefill.hit_ratio > 70% on Console tile
- If hit_ratio < 50% -> toggle canary model + ping #customer-success-escalations
- Enable streaming heartbeats in UI

Rafael (SRE): I'll add the metrics and alert. Jules can you add the prefilling endpoint rate-limit and shared-cache fallback?

Jules (Eng): On it. I'll also add a small latency trace that CS can open from the Console session view.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll add the checklist to the CS kickoff modal and update the onboarding playbook. Will post a one-pager after we validate on 3 more customers.

Samira (Customer): Thanks everyone, big improvement for demos.

Priya (Solutions): One more note: capture customer feedback after go-live with a 1-question pulse (was response snappy? y/n) — wire that into the enablement ticket so CS + Eng can iterate.

Maya (CS): Good idea. I'll add that to the CS post-demo workflow.

deploy-bot: Thread archived after 1 day of inactivity.
